outcome: Enable an Ontology Steward to inspect, snapshot, retrieve from, validate, and reconcile source drift for explicitly registered project-owned ontologies through immutable admitted epochs and separate content-addressed candidate epochs, without transferring meaning ownership or decision authority to the runtime.
scope: Manage only owner-configured local ontology packages through exact registration checks, selector-bound snapshots, bounded record retrieval, faithful native-validation wrapping, and append-only staging of source drift as reviewable successor candidates.
exclusions: ontology discovery, semantic authoring, inference, automatic repair, admission, or promotion
rewriting admitted epochs, refreshing an admitted registration in place, or changing native validator results
owner review, acceptance, publication, release, deployment, or network effects
arbitrary filesystem reads, uploads, agents, or remote services

challenge_route: Challenge product meaning through the Ontology Product owner, definition meaning through definitions governance, construction through DomainSpec v2 owners, and any package result through that ontology's native owner route.
claim_limit: Schema-conforming candidate Product Capability only; no adoption, admitted system ontology, accepted implementation baseline, conformance, native ontology acceptance, publication, release, or deployment.
